verified_facts.text: The building was designed by WATG, with interiors by the late Jaya Ibrahim.
verified_facts.excerpt: the building is designed by WATG, while the late Jaya Ibrahim crafted the interior designs and John Pettigrew oversees the landscape design.

verified_facts.text: The resort is close to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou.
verified_facts.excerpt: situated in close proximity to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou

verified_facts.text: The villas have sweeping views of the Minshan mountains and a design drawing from Tibetan culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature sweeping views of the Minshan mountains and design drawing from Tibetan culture.

verified_facts.text: Each guest is guided by a dedicated Nieba, a personal host who offers local knowledge and connects guests to resort experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are guided by a dedicated Nieba who serves as a source of local knowledge and connection to resort experiences.

verified_facts.text: Bathroom amenities were created in collaboration with Frédéric Malle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathroom amenities were created in collaboration with Parisian “perfume publisher” Frédéric Malle.

verified_facts.text: La Montagne is a specialty restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine with local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: This specialty restaurant reveals the flavors of Mediterranean cuisine with rich local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Cai Lin Xuan serves traditional Sichuan, Tibetan and Cantonese cuisines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cai Lin Xuan brings the beauty, colors and bounty of the surrounding landscape to the table through traditional Sichuan, Tibetan and Cantonese cuisines.

verified_facts.text: Bo Ri Village serves local comfort food, with Sichuan noodles and family hot pot among its specialties.
verified_facts.excerpt: Local specialties include Sichuan noodles and family hot pot.

verified_facts.text: Rissai Spa has a heated indoor pool with a panoramic mountain view.
verified_facts.excerpt: a heated indoor pool with a panoramic mountain view.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Eaglewood Vibration Ritual combines Tibetan singing bowls with agarwood oil.
verified_facts.excerpt: this massage combines the soothing vibrations of Tibetan singing bowls with therapeutic agarwood oil to encourage a deep state of calm.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and has Technogym cardio machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 24-hour fitness center offers Technogym cardio machines

verified_facts.text: Guests can go hiking, biking or stargazing in the surrounding Jiuzhaigou nature reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore Jiuzhaigou’s 180,000-acre nature reserve with hiking and biking excursions or an evening of stargazing.

verified_facts.text: Tibetan journeys in the surrounding villages include home visits and incense workshops.
verified_facts.excerpt: home visits, incense workshops and other immersive experiences.

verified_facts.text: Children's activities include arts and crafts, treasure hunts, kite-flying and organic farming.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids are invited to discover Jiuzhaigou and the resort with arts and crafts, treasure hunts, kite-flying and organic farming.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers limousine transportation to and from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer limousine transportation to and from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport.

verified_facts.text: Guests can also fly by helicopter from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport to a nearby helipad, where the resort can arrange transportation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may also travel from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport via helicopter to a nearby helipad where we can arrange transportation to the resort.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.
